title: Points Nights Beside a Replacement Award: Free Night Awards Reduction Schedule
content:
The nights of a reservation not paid with Free Night Awards lower the price of a replacement's night on it. When a member applies a replacement among the Free Night Awards to a night of a Reward Night Rate reservation, the points-night reduction counts the reservation's nights not paid with Free Night Awards: at least the upper points-night count earns the upper replacement points reduction, exactly one such night the lower replacement points reduction, and none nothing. It is taken off the replacement's night price once.

The nights not paid with Free Night Awards are the nights booked on the reservation less the nights on it paid with Free Night Awards, as its Room Reservations record shows them.

| Nights not paid with Free Night Awards | Points-night reduction |
|---|---|
| 2 or more (upper points-night count) | 2000 points (upper replacement points reduction) |
| Exactly 1 | 1000 points (lower replacement points reduction) |
| None | No points-night reduction |

A hypothetical four-night reservation with one night paid by the replacement has three nights not paid with awards and takes 2000 points; a two-night reservation with one award night takes 1000 points; a one-night reservation paid by the replacement takes nothing.
